instructions: Cook spaghetti per package directions; reserve a splash of pasta water.
Warm shrimp in a skillet, 2 minutes.
Toss pasta, pesto, shrimp, and tomato with the pasta water.
Serve with Sparkling mineral water (Topo Chico-class) (355 g).
